youtube.title: George Washington retired and opened a whiskey distillery 🥃 #shorts
youtube.caption:
George Washington won a war, became the first president… then retired and opened a whiskey distillery. 🥃

Comment the reply YOU would've sent George 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1797 his Scottish farm manager James Anderson talked Washington into building a distillery at Mount Vernon. By 1799 it made about 11,000 gallons of whiskey, one of the largest distilleries in America.
